metrics: boundary precision, recall, F1, and matched MAE at tolerance 3 where truth is defined

runtime, peak RSS, warnings, exceptions, and nonfinite diagnostics

abort_rules: abort before execution if the result directory already contains a full result
abort if the code revision or configuration is not committed and hashable
abort or record failed when any required score is NaN or positive infinity
retain null, reversed, failed, nonconverged, and timed-out outcomes
run each EP fit in a subprocess with a 20-second timeout and retain timeout as the outcome
require renewed resource approval if the pilot projects more than 30 minutes wall time or 4 GiB peak RSS
do not interpret model-derived agreement as external truth
do not execute the full suite until the pilot record is reviewed and explicitly approved
